info.title: icom OS - REST API
info.description: This documentation describes the REST API which can be used to configure and monitor all icom OS devices by INSYS icom

profile.name: profile
profile.description: Which profile to use for the request. Last activated profile is used, if ommited.

download_ascii.name: ascii_config
download_ascii.description: Which ascii config should be downloaded.

log_file.name: log_file
log_file.description: Which log file or archive should be downloaded.

tcp_dump.name: file
tcp_dump.description: Tcpdump file. File name is numeric and randomly generated.

file.name: file
file.description: Enter existing support package file or type 'latest' to get the last created file.

return_size.name: return_size
return_size.description: Do not return the list but only count the (filtered) list and return the size. This parameter can have any value or can be sent without a value. If omitted, the list is returned.

list_files.name: list_files
list_files.description: List all available files to download for this resource.

profile_list.description: Comma separated list of profiles to delete

ascii_config_list.description: Comma separated list of ascii configs to delete

list_uid.name: list_uid
list_uid.description: list_uid of the certificate or key to download

firmware_name.name: name
firmware_name.description: Which firmware of the given type to delete.

container_list.description: Comma separated list of containers to delete

licence_list.name: licence_list
licence_list.description: Comma separated list of licences to delete

licence.name: licence
licence.description: Name of OSS licence to download

profile_left.name: profile_left
profile_left.description: An existing profile on a device

profile_right.name: profile_right
profile_right.description: Further existing profile on a device

append_scheme.name: append_scheme
append_scheme.description: Append a scheme of the ressource in the answer.

filter.name: filter
filter.description:
Filter answer list according to parameters and values.
    Each filter is coded as json object.
    Multiple filters can be applied as array of json objects and are concatenated AND manner.

    Each Filter consists of three parameters:
        "p" : "paramater to filter on"
        "o" : "operator to use for the filter, can be "eq" for a complete match or "like"
        "v" : "value to filter the parameter according to the operator or array of values to result in an OR filter on that field"

    Example for filtering on one parameter:
        {"p" : "param_name", "o" : "eq", "v" : ["value1","value2"]}

    Example for filtering on two parameters:
        [{"p" : "param_name_1", "o" : "eq",   "v" : "value_1"},
        {"p" : "param_name_2", "o" : "like", "v" : "value_2"}]

delete.name: delete
delete.description: Determines, whether the whole list entry or only the filtered sublist entry should be deleted. Defaults to whole list entry if omitted.

firmware_type.name: type
firmware_type.description: Which type of firmware should be deleted.
